title: Once For All
firstLine: Free from the law, O, happy condition,

lines: Free from the law, O, happy condition,
Jesus hath bled, and there is remission;
Cursed by the law and bruised by the fall,
Grace hath redeemed us once for all.
Now are we free there's no condemnation,
"Come unto Me," O, hear His sweet call,
Come, unto Jesus once for all.
Truly His grace will help us from falling;
Passing from death to life at His call,
Once for all, O, sinner, receive it;
Once for all, O, won't you believe it;
Cling to the Savior, obey His call,
rist hath redeemed us once for all
